transcript:
Header:
Date: 2026-08-04
Start time: 16:00 UTC
Duration: 1h2m
Attendees: Elena Park, Marco Ruiz, Priya Nair, Samir Patel, Liang Zhou, Riley Gomez, Aisha Khan, Zoe Chen + all employees (joined via livestream)

Summary:
- Elena opened with product and customer highlights.
- Marco covered performance improvements and infra roadmap.
- Priya walked through product priorities and feature teams.
- Riley shared sales signals and enterprise requests.
- Q&A on hiring and Private deployment timelines.

Transcript:
00:00 Elena Park: All right good afternoon everyone, thanks for joining, uh we've got about an hour, we'll try to keep it tight. Quick housekeeping - recording is on, stream is up.
00:12 Elena Park: First off, big congrats to the infra team, we shipped the continuous batching work to prod last week, noticed some customers already seeing token cost drop, that's huge. Marco, want to give a quick note on perf?
00:28 Marco Ruiz: Yeah thanks. The rollout was a bit bumpy - there were a couple of kube node oom incidents, but Liang and the SRE crew mitigated, we patched the autoscaler. End result, latency P95 improved by ~18% on our internal tests and cost per token down 11% for typical seq lengths. Might be some noisy edges for long context right now.
00:50 Priya Nair: Quick add - product will start recommending batching configs in the console next week, so customers will see suggestions for batching and cache hints. It's part of Optimize MVP.
01:05 Riley Gomez: From sales, we've seen more inbound from regulated industries asking about Private and on-prem, also a couple of FSI pilots asking for HSM/KMS integration details. We're leaning into a couple of large POCs.
01:20 Elena Park: Good. On metrics: revenue growth week-over-week is steady; NRR for Dedicated accounts is holding, churn low, but we want to accelerate expansion. Samir, hiring update?
01:35 Samir Patel: Hiring ramp - engineering is approved for 18 roles this quarter, we'll start hiring for infra, runtime, and a couple of senior infra engs. People Ops will post reqs next week. We're prioritizing folks with C++/GPU inference background and experience with quantized runtimes.
01:52 Aisha Khan: I'll coordinate the interview panels, will share timeline with hiring managers by Thursday.
02:03 Liang Zhou: On the Private deployment front, we had two customers finish initial onboarding to the private control plane this month. There are some gaps in the docs around network setup - we need to update the VPC guide to include iptables and firewall recommendations.
02:22 Priya Nair: Also we need to tighten the audit log UX, customers asked for per-route logs and retention controls. Add to product backlog.
02:35 Zoe Chen: Marketing will run a campaign focused on "production-grade inference" next month, highlighting latency and cost case studies - we can use the infra team's numbers.
02:48 Riley Gomez: A quick note on competitive landscape - OpenAI and Anthropic keep pushing hosted features, but our differentiation is Dedicated and Private with better unit economics for enterprise. We're seeing a few deals where cost predictability is the deciding factor.
03:05 Elena Park: OK let's go through top Qs submitted. First: timeline for on-prem package GA?
03:12 Marco Ruiz: We expect beta by end of Q3, GA early Q4 assuming no major infra blockers. The remaining work is orchestration and packaging for air-gapped installs, plus a hardened installer.
03:25 Audience (Q): Any estimates on latency targets for Dedicated?
03:27 Samir Patel (transcribed as Speaker 5): Our internal SLA target for Dedicated is 100-200ms for common small models at P95; it depends on model and sequence length. We're tuning kernels and batching to get lower.
03:45 Audience (Q): Will there be self-serve capacity scaling for Dedicated?
03:49 Liang Zhou: Yes - autoscaling policies are in the console roadmap; customers will be able to set min/max pools and burst options. We're currently prototyping the policy UI.
04:05 Priya Nair: Roadmap highlight - over the next quarter product will prioritize: 1) Optimize suggestions for batching/caching, 2) Private/on-prem GA, 3) Audit logs + retention controls, 4) Structured output and function-calling polish.
04:25 Elena Park: Financial ask - we need to be mindful of spend as we ramp hiring, so teams should justify hires with clear impact for Q4.
04:36 Aisha Khan: We'll run a hiring intake review process starting next week to align priorities.
04:45 Riley Gomez: Sales decks - please review the updated enterprise pitch deck in marketing drive; added a slide around "cost-aware performance" and routing policy examples.
04:58 Zoe Chen: We'll also share a benchmark spreadsheet with numbers for P95 latency and cost per 1k tokens across model families.
05:10 Audience (Q): Any update on SOC2 timeline?
05:13 Marco Ruiz: SOC2 readiness - audit prep is on track, control evidence collection is ongoing. We're aiming for completion mid-Q4.
05:22 Elena Park: Great. Last block is shoutouts and wins - shoutout to infra, SRE, and solutions eng for recent POC wins. Also to Riley's team for closing three mid-market contracts.
05:40 Elena Park: Ok closing notes - managers, please push OKRs by end of week. Product to publish roadmap doc by Aug 18. People Ops to publish hiring plan. Any final questions?
05:55 Audience Member (crosstalk): Quick question on discounts for Dedicated -
05:57 Riley Gomez: We'll follow up offline, finance is working on updated pricing tiers for reserved capacity.
06:05 Elena Park: All right thanks everyone, see you next month.

End of transcript.
